stubs.how: index.html points context.apiConnections at the page's own origin; .ui-capture/stub-server.mjs implements capabilities, map.json?bbox, node/way/relation (+full, versions, relations), nodes/ways/relations multi-fetch, user/details, users, user/{id}, user/preferences, changesets?user, notes (bbox, single, comment/close/reopen/create), and changeset create/upload/close (returns a valid diffResult so Save round-trips) from .ui-capture/data/world.json

Rapid's own context.preauth hook with a placeholder access token ('local-stub-oauth2-token'); the stub accepts any bearer token and returns the riverbend_maya account. No password exists or is needed.

stub-server.mjs renders aerial-looking 256px PNG tiles on the fly from the seeded OSM data (.ui-capture/tiles.mjs) at /tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png; used as the user's saved Custom background (localStorage background-custom-template). The Mapbox locator overlay is switched off via the URL hash (overlays=).

notes: Rapid 2.5.7 (Meta's AI-assisted OpenStreetMap editor), production bundle (dist/rapid.min.js) built with the repo's own `npm run all` on node 22.12.0 (pinned in mise.toml). .ui-capture/build-site.sh assembles .ui-capture/site (dist + local copies of CDN assets + an index.html adjusted only for offline/local API use). .ui-capture/start.sh runs .ui-capture/stub-server.mjs, which serves the site and all stubs on $PORT (4487). Data: .ui-capture/gen-world.mjs builds data/world.json from the real OSM extract of Three Rivers, Michigan that ships with Rapid (data/intro_graph.json: ~5,900 nodes/ways/relations - ~350 buildings, streets, river, parks, ~40 named shops/amenities), given realistic OSM ids, versions, timestamps, editors and changesets spread 2009-2026, plus light enrichment (addresses, opening hours, phones, building levels). Signed-in user riverbend_maya (account since 2019, 1,287 changesets, 3 unread messages) with 90 commented changesets over 2019-2026 (70 in the last 9 months) shown in the save panel's recent comments; ~1/3 of features were last edited by them (History panel). 22 OSM notes (open and closed, with discussion threads). 15 other mappers. Esri datasets 'St. Joseph County, MI Address Points' (158 suggested address points on unaddressed buildings) and 'City of Three Rivers Sidewalks' (34 sidewalk lines) are enabled as Rapid AI/open-data suggestions. Browser state (seed-prefs.js, applied once to localStorage) makes it a returning user: welcome/what's-new already seen, walkthrough completed, recent presets, hashtag #MapThreeRivers, last changeset comment, Custom imagery as last-used background. If opened without a map hash it jumps to the user's home area in downtown Three Rivers at z17. Main areas: map canvas with OSM data and imagery; top bar (Point/Line/Area/Note, Rapid AI features toggle, undo/redo, Save, account menu with avatar); right-hand map controls and panes (Background, Map Data incl. notes layer and Rapid datasets, Issues, Preferences, Help, keyboard shortcuts); selecting a feature opens the left inspector (preset, fields, tags, history). Rebuild everything: `.ui-capture/build-site.sh && node .ui-capture/gen-world.mjs`. Not verified in a real browser from inside the build sandbox (Chromium cannot launch under the macOS sandbox); all served URLs were checked with HTTP requests.
